documentation: Unseeded Random / Random.Default calls compile to plain math.random with no helper code. Random(seed) is a port of Kotlin's XorWow generator (src/main/resources/runtime/random.lua), so every seeded Random is independent and produces the same sequence as the JVM.

declarations.name: Random
declarations.documentation: Random.Default / Random → math.random; Random(seed: Int) → an independent seeded XorWow generator matching Kotlin. A Long seed is not supported

declarations.name: nextInt
declarations.documentation: Full Int range; seeded instances match Kotlin bit for bit

declarations.name: nextInt
declarations.documentation: from inclusive, until exclusive; also covers nextInt(until)

declarations.name: nextDouble
declarations.documentation: [0, 1); also covers nextDouble(until) and nextDouble(from, until)
